game.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
game.blurb: Open-world western action-adventure from Rockstar Games, released 2018-10-26 (PC 2019). RAWG average playtime: 21 hours (well under a full run). Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang's story, chapter by chapter to the epilogue.

chapters.title: Camp and Honor
chapters.summary: Life in camp: donations, errands, companion activities and your Honor level.

chapters.title: Strangers and Side Stories
chapters.summary: Stranger missions, homestead stashes, mysteries and minigames.

chapters.title: Collectibles, Crafting and 100%
chapters.summary: Collectable strands, crafting, gold medals and full completion.

chapters.title: Hunting, Fishing and Horses
chapters.summary: Study and skin animals, big fish, bears and bonding with your horse.

chapters.title: Outlaw Life
chapters.summary: Robbing, spending, bounties and weapon upgrades.

chapters.title: Red Dead Online
chapters.summary: The online mode: ranks, posses, Free Roam missions and events.

notes: StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0) with only 2 written subpages, so it gives no usable structure. reddead.fandom.com answers the API with about 351 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 12 of 51 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter. 17 achievements are for Red Dead Online.
